name: Cold Reading
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Steve Cambridge: Master Grifter, System Update 2021's Criminal identity, who on the first successful run on HQ each turn chooses 2 cards in the heap, the Corp removes 1 from the game and the Runner takes the other. On Hit List's frame after Tranche 8 Stage 11l, its identity swapped, a Criminal for a Criminal at the same fifteen influence; Hit List runs HQ every turn for Gabriel Santiago, and its events fill the heap Steve draws on. Tranche 8 Stage 11v. FFG F1 Stage 2: Doppelgänger for its Desperado, a console for a console, which runs again once a turn when a successful run ends; and two Mr. Li for its two Asmund Pudlat, a resource that draws two and puts one back. Hit List keeps both. FFG F2 Stage 1: two Bankroll for its two Data Dealer, a credit banked on every successful run and taken all at once by trashing it; and two Hot Pursuit for its two Inside Job, a run event for a run event: HQ, 9[credit] and a tag. Hit List keeps both. FFG F2 Stage 6: Thunder Art Gallery for its The Back, a card installed a credit cheaper the first time each turn a tag is avoided or removed; The Back is still in other decks. Kitara Stage 6a: two Credit Kiting for two WAKE Implant v2A-JRJ. Kitara Stage 7a: two Amina for two Jeitinho. Kitara Stage 14a: two Slipstream for its two Networking, so a passed piece of ice can carry the Runner to a central server's ice in the same position.
